The '''2023 ROTJ 40 Open''' was one of two [[Players Committee]] [[GEMP]] leagues marking the 40th anniversary of ''Return of the Jedi''. It ran from 25 May – 4 July 2023 in [[Open]], with required starting cards, and ketwol finished first.<ref name="rotj40">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1406789#p1406789 ROTJ 40 Events!], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (25 May 2023).</ref><ref name="deadline">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1409388#p1409388 ROTJ 40 Events!], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (4 July 2023).</ref><ref name="rotj40open">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1409420#p1409420 OPEN ROTJ 40 - Final Standings], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (5 July 2023).</ref>

Players who completed eight games received participation prizes. Performance prizes went to the top 8.<ref name="rotj40" />
